title: SXTN Feature Index
description: Project-level feature index emitted by sxtn-design-ingest. One entry per discovered feature. Validates .sxtn/feature-index.yaml.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last ingest run

source.description: Drop folder path that was consumed to produce this index

features.description: One entry per discovered feature. Merged on repeated ingest (idempotent by feature key).

feature.description: Kebab-case feature identifier derived from filename/component context

tier.description: Feature tier. Defaults to 'default' when not derivable from source.

domains.description: One or more domains this feature belongs to. Derived from module/feature naming.

modules.description: Modules that implement this feature (from component index module field).

component_keys.description: All index_keys from the component index entries that belong to this feature.
